body: This PR looks finished to us: it merges cleanly with main, the body names the issue, the tests and the Changelog line, and there have been no new commits for some hours. Our review agents only review PRs marked **Ready for review**, so a draft waits without a review. When you think it is done, please click **Ready for review** (or `gh pr ready 2565`), and it gets a review in the next pass. If it is still in progress, ignore this comment.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4662573e3ab205f52dce7ac3a1abc5a3c7028055 -->
**Review: clean. Verdict: merge-ready.** Reviewed by the SlaveSession PR-reviewer agent (built review). From an account that is not a collaborator: the maintainer approves and merges by hand. (A queue note before this said a review was posted at 02:43; it never reached GitHub. This is the review of record.)

**Built.** Head `4662573e3` merged with current `main` (trial merge, no conflicts).
- `camcraft-app`: `probe_pick`, `setup_align`, `setup_align_2d_kinds`, `setup_align_mill_turn`, `setup_align_multiaxis`, `setup_align_probe_kinds`, `opframe_picks`: 4+9+10+8+2+10+2 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Checks.**
- The seed now reads `setup_align::pose_in` - the same pose the generation arm already used since #2210, so the two reads cannot disagree. One derivation, per the WCS/alignment law.
- `Probe` joins `verified_mill` only; `verified_turn` and the `lathe_voice` refusal are untouched, as the body states.
- The five sentinels keep their teeth: each now names a still-unverified kind, and the mill-turn suite gains the Probe admission assert. The refusal text names Probe.
- Gouge law: the negative-control pin shows the stylus law convicts the old model-frame target (Gouge at moves 3 to 6), so the silent 10 mm-inside cycle cannot pass this gate.
- Commands: the seed is written at command creation (`SetOperationGeometry` path), not in a system.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/2285-probe-turned-setup.md` present; `Changelog:` line in the body.

**Note.** A pose change after the op is made re-stamps the op; the stored target is then refused or re-seeded by the pick command, as with the other geometry-seeded parameters. No new gap found.

Merge class: SAME. The head `4662573e3ab205f52dce7ac3a1abc5a3c7028055` is the reviewed head. No commit came after the review, and the PR merges cleanly with `main` without a refresh.

This merge relies on the built review of this head by the SlaveSession PR-reviewer agent (2026-11-19 05:19 UTC). The main session relayed the order to merge this PR. The PR fixes a P3 and touches no P1, so it needs no second review.

Thank you for the fix.
